# fmc_distinguished_name (Resource)

This resource manages a Distinguished Name.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `7.4`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_distinguished_name" "example" {
  name               = "my_distinguished_name"
  distinguished_name = "C=US,CN=example.com,O=Example,OU=IT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `distinguished_name` (String) The value of the distinguished name, provided as comma-separated attribute-value pairs (for example `CN=example.com,OU=IT,O=Example,C=US`).
- `name` (String) Name of the Distinguished Name object.

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'DistinguishedName'.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_distinguished_name.example "<domain>,<id>"
```
